description: This file contains implementations of nested tensor factory functions and utilities for the ATen library in PyTorch, including functions for creating, cloning, unbinding, and copying nested tensors, as well as verifying parameters.

methods.name: verify_empty_parameters
methods.description: Verifies and constructs TensorOptions for creating empty nested tensors with specific memory formats and layouts.

methods.name: empty_like_nested
methods.description: Creates a nested tensor similar to the input tensor, with options for data type, layout, device, and memory format.

methods.name: ensure_has_index
methods.description: Ensures the device has a valid device index, returning the device with the actual device at call time.

methods.name: _to_copy_nested
methods.description: Copies data from one nested tensor to another with specified options.

methods.name: copy_nested_
methods.description: In-place copy of data from source nested tensor to destination nested tensor.

methods.name: clone_nested
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of a nested tensor with specified memory format.

methods.name: NestedTensor_unbind
methods.description: Unbinds a nested tensor along dimension 0 into a vector of tensors.

methods.name: narrow_nested_symint
methods.description: Narrows a nested tensor along dimension 0 with symbolic integer start and length.

methods.name: alias_nested
methods.description: Returns a view of the nested tensor as a regular tensor.
